Command: No uncircumcised person shall eat the Passover
Summary: No uncircumcised male may eat the Passover; circumcision was the entry into the covenant meal.
Commandment: No uncircumcised person shall eat the Passover.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. Circumcision marked belonging to the covenant people, and the Passover meal belonged to that people.
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the meal is eaten in haste on the night of deliverance from Egypt, ready to depart (Exodus 12:11).
